 2                ACTING PRESIDENT GRIFFO:   The

 9                ACTING PRESIDENT GRIFFO:   Today's 

10   invocation will be offered by the Reverend Jason 

11   Kleber, senior pastor at Coila Church in 

12   Cambridge.

13                Reverend?  

14                REVEREND KLEBER:   Thank you.  

15                Let's pray.  

16                Our most gracious and sovereign 

17   Lord and our loving Heavenly Father, we come 

18   before You today in thanksgiving and praise for 

19   who You are.  You alone are God, and You alone 

20   are worthy of all our praise.  

21                And we thank You, Father, that You 

22   have given us life and liberty and all the other 

23   blessings and freedoms we enjoy each day.  And 

24   we acknowledge before You that they are all 

25   gracious gifts sent from Your hand.  


                                                                516

 1                And I thank You, Lord, for this 

 2   Senate body and the work that You have given them 

 3   to do.  It is indeed Your work, for You are the 

 4   great Eternal Lawgiver and from You and Your Holy 

 5   Word flows all conception of right and wrong.  

 6                So we ask that what is done here 

 7   today would be pleasing in Your sight, and that 

 8   it would reflect Your righteous character and 

 9   just nature.  And we ask that it would also be 

10   for the good of this great state and the good of 

11   the citizens that those gathered here represent.  

12                And we thank You, Father, that You 

13   also are so infinitely good Yourself.  And You 

14   displayed that goodness in full measure when You 

15   sent Your only son to die for sinners like us.  

16   May we be ever mindful of that and recognize that 

17   the ultimate reason we have laws and government 

18   is because they serve as a restraining force 

19   against sin.  

20                But in the person of Your son, You 

21   have brought the ultimate remedy to the sin that 

22   besets us all.  And in Your son the ultimate 

23   demands of Your law were met.  

24                So I thank You, Father, that because 

25   of that I can stand here before You today in 


                                                                517

 1   prayer.  And it's on that basis that I ask Your 

 2   blessing upon this assembly and all that is said 

 3   and done here today, for it is in the name of 

 4   Your son, our only Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, 

 5   that I ask these things.  

 6                Amen.

16   Resolution Number 210, by Senator Ritchie, 

17   congratulating the Indian River Central School 

18   Football Team upon the occasion of capturing the 

19   Class A New York State Championship.  

20                "WHEREAS, Excellence and success in 

21   competitive sports can only be achieved through 

22   strenuous practice, team play, and team spirit, 

23   nurtured by dedicated coaching and strategic 

24   planning; and 

25                "WHEREAS, It is the intent of this 


                                                                521

 1   Legislative Body to recognize those young people 

 2   within our community, who, by achieving  

 3   outstanding success in athletic competitions,  

 4   have inspired and brought pride to their school 

 5   district and community; and 

 6                "WHEREAS, Attendant to such concern, 

 7   and in full accord with its longstanding 

 8   traditions, this Legislative Body is justly proud 

 9   to congratulate the Indian River Central School 

10   Football Team upon the occasion of capturing the 

11   New York State Class A Championship; and 

12                "WHEREAS, Indian River won the 

13   Class A Championship by defeating the previously 

14   undefeated defending state champions from  

15   Queensbury 63-38, at the Carrier Dome in Syracuse 

16   on Sunday, November 30, 2014; and 

17                "WHEREAS, The Indian River Warriors 

18   fell behind early on in the game, 19-0, but never 

19   lost heart, steadily climbing back into 

20   competition with a dominant rushing performance, 

21   to win the game and end their season with an 

22   impressive record of 13-0; and 

23                "WHEREAS, The athletic talent 

24   displayed by this team is due in great part to 

25   the dedication of their many family, fans, 


                                                                522

 1   friends, and the community at large, who came out 

 2   in force to cheer the Indian River Warriors to 

 3   victory, and who loyally and enthusiastically 

 4   supported the team throughout their season; and

 8   John Kemp is the president and the CEO of the 

 9   Henry Viscardi School.  

10                And for those of you who don't know 

11   about the Henry Viscardi School, the Henry 

12   Viscardi School is a 4201 school in New York 

13   State.  It's located in Albertson, New York.  And 

14   it is a very special 4201 school because it 

15   caters exclusively to children who are severely 

16   physically handicapped.

17                And so all of the students in 

18   downstate -- not only from Long Island, from 

19   New York City, even from as far away as 

20   Westchester -- if they have a physical disability 

21   and a severe physical disability and they're 

22   lucky, they end up going to the Henry Viscardi 

23   School, where they do miracles and perform 

24   miracles each and every day in terms of allowing 

25   children opportunities that they otherwise would 


                                                                529

 3   awarded the Dole Leadership Prize.  Now, to put 

 4   that into context, past recipients of the Dole 

 5   Leadership Prize have been world leaders like 

 6   Lech Walesa, the former president of Poland.  

 7   They've been national leaders like Rudy Giuliani, 

 8   U.S. Senators, people who have gone on to change 

 9   the world.

11   of them because of his advocacy, because of his 

12   example, because of the life he leads and the 

13   ability he has to change children's lives each 

14   and every day.

16   inspirational person because he deals with that 

17   which we just spoke about; John goes through life 

18   with four prosthetics.  Yet he never allowed that 

19   to slow him down.

21   University, he got his legal degree from Washburn

24   different disability organizations in our
